children.text: Reach more, sell more, and run smarter, faster, better with purpose-built, AI-driven solutions designed around all the ways you do business.

altText.value: BigCommerce agentic ecosystem diagram showing discovery, checkout, operations, and infrastructure components.

text.value: The rules are being rewritten. AI is completely reshaping how products are discovered, how shoppers make decisions, and how businesses manage the work behind every interaction.

children.text: Your playbook for success in the age of agents.

Agentic commerce is not a single channel, feature, or experience. It requires products prepared for every surface, intelligent assistance across daily operations, more helpful paths to purchase, and open infrastructure for creating what comes next.
Put AI to work behind the scenes
An open foundation for what comes next
Ensure your products can be discovered and purchased on any platform.

Prepare, enrich, and distribute product data across storefronts, channels, and emerging AI experiences. Make your catalog easier for search engines, shopping agents, and customers to find, understand, and act on.

altText.value: E-commerce catalog management dashboard displaying a "Products are being enriched" loading bar.

children.text: Built directly into BigCommerce, Catalog Enrichment generates titles, descriptions, feature bullets, FAQs, and metadata in bulk while keeping merchants in control of every change.
Turn incomplete and inconsistent catalog data into rich, brand aligned content optimized for advertising, marketplaces, search, and emerging shopping destinations.
Make products discoverable across AI powered shopping experiences with accurate, structured catalog data prepared for how intelligent agents understand and recommend products.
Empower teams to move faster and get more done with less effort.

Bring intelligent assistance into everyday operations so teams can find answers, surface insights, and complete routine work more efficiently. Give people more time to focus on the decisions and opportunities that move the business forward.

altText.value: BigCommerce Companion AI assistant interface displaying prompt suggestions on a modal card.

children.text: Companion brings a store-aware assistant into the BigCommerce control panel, giving merchants a faster, conversational way to complete catalog, customer, and operational tasks.
Describe the catalog change you need once, then apply it across multiple products through a guided workflow that replaces repetitive manual editing.
Translate the catalog content for your buyers' languages directly within BigCommerce and skip the manual workflows.
Localize complete storefront experiences while preserving the layouts, components, and creative control already established in Makeswift.
Turn more moments of intent into confident buying decisions.

Create conversational experiences that guide shoppers and buyers from initial discovery through checkout. Answer questions, surface relevant products, and give everyone the clarity and confidence to complete their purchase.

altText.value: Woman holding smartphone displaying AI shopping assistant recommendations for women's cowboy boots.

children.text: Shoppers can search using natural questions instead of exact keywords. Semantic understanding connects their intent with the most relevant products in the catalog.
From uncertain needs to confident decisions, Shopping Agent answers questions, compares options, and guides each shopper toward the right product and purchase.
Transform complex purchase order workflows into streamlined buyer experiences that simplify and speed up ordering, validation, and checkout.
Create differentiated experiences through an open, interoperable ecosystem.

Use open APIs, MCP servers, and developer tools to connect agents, data, platforms, and workflows. Give internal teams and partners the flexibility to create varied experiences around the needs of your business.

altText.value: E-commerce checkout interface modal displayed over underlying code.

children.text: Bring BigCommerce storefront and management capabilities into your agent-led workflows with a unified connection layer.
Give agents direct access to guest shopping flows grounded in live catalog data, including product discovery, product details, and cart creation.
Bring authenticated buyer context into agentic experiences, including customer specific pricing, product access, shopping lists, quotes, and complex purchasing workflows.
Connect compatible agents and developer tools with BigCommerce management capabilities so store context can become secure, actionable operational workflows.

altText.value: Minimalist black window icon with a four-point sparkle symbol on a light yellow background.

children.text: Bring your agentic commerce strategy to life.

In a future where intelligent experiences make buying easier and businesses more efficient, BigCommerce gives you the foundation to move with greater speed, act on deeper insight, and grow with confidence.

consentPreferenceCenter.title: Privacy Preference Center
consentPreferenceCenter.description: When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.

strictlyNecessary.title: Strictly Necessary Cookies
strictlyNecessary.description: These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

functional.title: Functional Cookies
functional.description: These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

performance.title: Performance Cookies
performance.description: These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

targeting.title: Targeting Cookies
targeting.description: These cookies may be set through our site by us and/or our third-party service providers. They may be used by us and/or our third-party service providers to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites and/or devices. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
